question: Where may the mantra be installed during the consecration procedure?
premises: A pedestal made of bricks is a possible locus.
The liṅga is an alternative locus.
The mantra must be installed in one of these loci.
inference: Therefore one should install the mantra either on a brick-made pedestal or in the liṅga.
plain_english: One should install the mantra either on a pedestal made of bricks or in the liṅga.
